title: Zone 51: Virus Nocturnus
description: A third-person survival horror shooter set in abandoned Tijuana. Explore enterable houses and rooftops, scavenge ammo and med kits, and fight fast, vampire-like infected with your pistol, rifle and machete. Rest at campfires to save and level up, and survive the nights when the red moon rises and the Alpha hunts.
features: Third-person shooting with over-the-shoulder aim, plus machete combos and finishers
Souls-style dodge roll, stamina, lock-on and campfire checkpoints
Climb walls and run across the rooftops of a 3D Tijuana
Day and night cycle: few infected by day, fast hunters under the red moon
Full controller support (Xbox and PlayStation) and keyboard + mouse

minimum.cpu: Intel Core i5 (4 cores) / AMD Ryzen 3
